card.name: Inside personal names and decimal points
card.fires_on: Partway through a person's name, especially a surname after a first name or title (Debra St-amm, Santo Lo-quasto, Mr. Tom). Also the decimal point inside a number like 3.9.

modes.label: Title period
modes.description: The period after Mr before a first name.
modes.example: Mr<<.>> Tom Robinson's left hand become handi

card.writes: It pushes toward unusual word pieces and away from digits and number tokens, so it adds little clear output.
